## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle (10卷) **Cáodòng-Chán "direct-pointing" commentary** on the *Śūraṃgamasūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Tiānrán Hánshì** 天然圅昰 [圅昰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%85%E6%98%B0) (1608 – 1685), the principal late-Míng / early-Qīng Cáodòng master of the **Lǐngnán** 嶺南 region. Together with the accompanying *Zhízhǐ kēwén* ([KR6j0698](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0698)), the work forms Hánshì's complete *Lèngyán* exegetical apparatus. Preserved as **X14 no. 291** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The catalog meta classes the dynasty as 明; the work was actually completed in the very early Qīng period, but Hánshì's persona as a *yímín* 遺民 ("Míng-loyalist remnant") makes this Míng-classification idiomatic.

**Abstract**

The preface attests that Hánshì composed the *Zhízhǐ* in three months while in seated retreat at **Dānxiásì** 丹霞寺 (in Guǎngdōng) — most plausibly during one of his Lǐngnán residency periods between his early establishment at Léifēng (1640s) and his late-life Lúshān period (1670s–1685). The genre name *zhízhǐ* 直指 ("direct-pointing") signals a **Chán-tradition reading** that prioritizes the sūtra's teaching as a Dharma-seal for direct mind-pointing, in contrast to the *Tiāntái-doctrinal* reading of [傳燈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E7%87%88)'s *Yuántōng shū* ([KR6j0689](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0689)) and the *philological-doctrinal* reading of [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91)'s *Zhèngmài shū* ([KR6j0683](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0683)).

Hánshì was one of the leading figures of the **Lǐngnán Cáodòng revival** of the late-Míng / early-Qīng transition; together with [弘麗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E9%BA%97) Hónglì and [弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A) Hóngzàn (his fellow Lǐngnán Cáodòng commentators) he forms the principal exegetical triad of the regional school. The *Zhízhǐ* is the most ambitious *Lèngyán* commentary from this triad and one of the principal Chán-school readings of the *Lèngyán* in the seventeenth century.

The dating bracket is set to **1640 – 1685**, the productive Cáodòng-school career of Hánshì.
